create_record.description: Create a record in any Odoo model (a contact, lead, sales order, product, task, and so on) and get back its new id.
create_record.name: create_record

parameters.description: Odoo model technical name, for example 'res.partner' (contacts & customers), 'crm.lead' (leads & opportunities), 'sale.order' (quotations & sales orders), 'product.template' (products), or 'project.task' (tasks).
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: The new record's field values as field-name to value pairs, for example name: 'Acme Inc.', email: 'contact@acme.com'. Use Odoo's technical field names; a many2one field (like a country) takes the related record's id.
parameters.name: values

id.description: Database id of the new record (use it as Record ID in Get, Update, or Delete).

model.description: The model the record was created in.

delete_record.description: Delete a record from an Odoo model by its id.
delete_record.name: delete_record

parameters.description: Odoo model technical name, for example 'res.partner' (contacts & customers), 'crm.lead' (leads & opportunities), 'sale.order' (quotations & sales orders), 'product.template' (products), or 'project.task' (tasks).
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: The database id of the record to delete.
parameters.name: record_id

id.description: The id of the deleted record.

model.description: The model the record belonged to.

get_record.description: Read a single Odoo record by its id: handy right after creating one, or once you have an id from a Search step.
get_record.name: get_record

parameters.description: Odoo model technical name, for example 'res.partner' (contacts & customers), 'crm.lead' (leads & opportunities), 'sale.order' (quotations & sales orders), 'product.template' (products), or 'project.task' (tasks).
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: The database id of the record to read (from a Create or Search step, or the record's URL in Odoo).
parameters.name: record_id

parameters.description: Optional list of field names to return. Leave empty to return every readable field.
parameters.name: fields

record.description: The record's field values, or an empty object if the id no longer exists.

search_read_records.description: Find records in an Odoo model that match a filter and read their fields in one call: the workhorse for listing contacts, open opportunities, recent orders, and the like.
search_read_records.name: search_read_records

parameters.description: Odoo model technical name, for example 'res.partner' (contacts & customers), 'crm.lead' (leads & opportunities), 'sale.order' (quotations & sales orders), 'product.template' (products), or 'project.task' (tasks).
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: Optional Odoo domain: a list of [field, operator, value] conditions, for example [["is_company", "=", true]] or [["email", "=", "contact@acme.com"]]. Leave empty to match every record.
parameters.name: domain

parameters.description: Optional list of field names to return, for example ['name', 'email', 'phone']. Leave empty to return every readable field.
parameters.name: fields

parameters.description: Optional maximum number of records to return.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Optional number of matching records to skip (for paging).
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Optional sort clause, for example 'create_date desc' or 'name asc'.
parameters.name: order

count.description: How many records this call returned.

records.description: Matching records, each an object of the requested field values plus its 'id'.

update_record.description: Change field values on an existing Odoo record: update a contact's details, move an opportunity's stage, and so on.
update_record.name: update_record

parameters.description: Odoo model technical name, for example 'res.partner' (contacts & customers), 'crm.lead' (leads & opportunities), 'sale.order' (quotations & sales orders), 'product.template' (products), or 'project.task' (tasks).
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: The database id of the record to update.
parameters.name: record_id

parameters.description: The fields to change and their new values, for example phone: '+1 555 0100'. Fields you leave out keep their current values.
parameters.name: values

id.description: The id of the updated record.

model.description: The model the record belongs to.

description: Create, search, read, update, and delete records in any Odoo model (contacts, CRM leads, sales orders, products, and more) through Odoo's External API.
